<cite ref="Taanit 25b:6">Taan. 25ᵇ</cite> <he>כמלא ב׳ חמחרישה</he> (Var. <cite ref="K00247"><he>כוך</he></cite>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l.) (until the rain penetrates) as far as the knee of the plough enters the soil; Ohol. XVII, 1 <cite ref="B01083"><he>בו׳</he></cite>.
Kel. XXI, 2 בו׳. [Tosef. Shebi. IV, 20 ברך, v. בְּרִיכָה.]—Du. בִּרְכַּיִם.

<cite ref="Berakhot 34b">Ber. 34ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Megillah 22b:10">Meg. 22ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Shevuot 16b:9">Shebu. 16ᵇ</cite> <he>כריעה על ב׳</he> the word <he>כרע</he> means falling on one’s knees. [<he>בִּרְכּוֹת</he>, v. <cite ref="B01267"><he>בְּרִיכָה</he></cite>.]
